heading: Civilian faculty members at certain Department of Defense schools: employment and compensation

tree.heading: Authority of Secretary.—
tree.text: The Secretary of Defense may employ as many civilians as professors, instructors, and lecturers at the organizations specified in subsection (c) as the Secretary considers necessary.

tree.heading: Compensation of Faculty Members.—
tree.text: The compensation of persons employed under this section shall be as prescribed by the Secretary.

tree.heading: Covered Organizations.—
tree.text: This section applies with respect to the following organizations of the Department of Defense:

children.text: The Foreign Language Center of the Defense Language Institute.
The English Language Center of the Defense Language Institute.
The Western Hemisphere Institute for Security Cooperation.
The Defense Institute for Security Governance.
The Defense Institute of International Legal Studies.
The United States Element of the Inter-American Defense College.

tree.heading: Application to Faculty Members at NDU.—
tree.text: In the case of the National Defense University, this section applies with respect to persons selected by the Secretary for employment as professors, instructors, and lecturers at the National Defense University after February 27, 1990.

notes.heading: Effect of 1992 Amendments on Current Employees
notes.text: Pub. L. 102–484, div. A, title IX, § 923(b), Oct. 23, 1992, 106 Stat. 2474, provided that: “In the case of a person who, on the day before the date of the enactment of this Act [Oct. 23, 1992], is employed as a professor, instructor, or lecturer at the Foreign Language Center of the Defense Language Institute, the Secretary of Defense shall afford the person an opportunity to elect to be paid under the compensation plan authorized by section 1595(b) of title 10, United States Code, or to continue to be paid under the General Schedule (with no reduction in pay) under section 5332 of title 5, United States Code.”
